title: Fél and negyed — halves and quarters

sections.title: Counting toward the next hour
sections.content: For halves and quarters, Hungarian names the hour you are heading TOWARD, not the one you just left. Fél tíz literally means 'half of ten', but it translates as 'half past nine' (9:30). Negyed tíz means 'a quarter of ten' — 'a quarter past nine' (9:15).
This trips up almost every learner at first: fél tíz is 9:30, not 10:30. Picture the clock hand climbing halfway toward ten, and the logic clicks into place.
